mentions.name: Family photo sharing app
mentions.description: A private photo sharing app for families that keeps photos off social media. Users upload a curated set of photos rather than their whole camera roll, create one or more family groups, and share individual photos or albums to those groups; members can view, comment on, and like the photos. It also generates shareable links with a configurable expiry for people without an account. It currently works on the web, with iOS and Android apps in development.
mentions.problem: Families want to share photos with relatives without putting them on social media.
mentions.audience: Families who want to keep their photos off of social media but still share with family.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a photo sharing app for families who want to keep their photos off of social media but still share with family.
